==Ingredients==

* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] dry [[Cookbook:Split Pea|split peas]], picked over
* 5–6 cups [[Cookbook:Water|water]]

==Procedure==

# Rinse the split peas well, and discard the water (potted plants love it!)
# Simmer the split peas in salted water for ¾–1 hour.
# Serve.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If you have hard water in your area, adding ⅛ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]] will reduce the cooking time.
* [[Cookbook:Bacon|Bacon]], [[Cookbook:Ham|ham]], kielbasa, [[Cookbook:Pork|salt pork]], or [[Cookbook:Sausage|smoked sausage]] may be added during cooking for added flavor.
